d:
US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth has survived an impeachment push over alleged violations of American law during military operations against Iran, Venezuela and Yemen. The proposal was introduced by Republican Congressman Thomas Massie, but Republicans largely stood by Hegseth and voted to send the matter to the House Judiciary Committee instead. What were the allegations against Hegseth? How did Trump’s party help him avoid impeachment? And could the effort return in 2027?
Production: Akash
Video Editor: Rahul Kumar
